pages.heading: Your current controls
pages.body: Bindings below are read from your Controls menu. Unbound means you need to assign a key; N/A means the binding is unavailable. Rebinding updates these references when the page opens. Context-specific overlaps can be intentional.

pages.body: Inventory: $(k:key.inventory)$(br)Use / interact: $(k:key.use)$(br)Sneak: $(k:key.sneak)$(br)Chat: $(k:key.chat)$(br)Journal: $(k:key.ftbquests.quests)$(br)The journal is also in the inventory sidebar.

pages.heading: Optional pack controls
pages.body: Run /kncraft controls for possible overlaps. Use /kncraft controls preset to apply the optional pack layout. It saves your old bindings. /kncraft controls restore restores unchanged preset bindings and keeps your later customizations.

pages.heading: Client features
pages.body: KNCraft supports Distant Horizons on the server. A matching client installation shows simplified distant terrain beyond the usual render distance. It does not extend interaction range or guarantee that distant mobs are visible. Simple Voice

pages.heading: Client features (cont.)
pages.body: Chat is also supported. Open its menu from your assigned key, select your microphone and output device, and check mute and push-to-talk settings. Key conflicts can be changed in Controls.

pages.heading: Before settling
pages.body: Gather food, wood, tools, light and a means of escape. Check your temperature before choosing a route. Keep supplies ready to carry; an elaborate starter base is a poor substitute for working equipment. KNCraft

pages.heading: Before settling (cont.)
pages.body: plans to spawn two Wither Storms at the end of the second Minecraft day. This is a server launch milestone, not a two-day grace period for every new player. Check BlueMap before leaving a safe location.

pages.heading: Recipes and controls
pages.body: JEI is included. Search an item, then use its recipe and uses controls to see how it is made and what it feeds into. Check the workstation tab as well as the ingredients. Several mods use the same default keys. Assign separate keys for the

pages.heading: Recipes and controls (cont.)
pages.body: backpack, voice chat and train controls. Better Combat changes weapon handling; test your weapon and its reach before a boss fight. Comforts sleeping bags are useful on trips without moving your normal spawn point.

pages.heading: Your first guide book
pages.body: You receive this guide once when joining the world. A carried copy counts; a full inventory delays delivery until space is free. Death and reconnecting do not grant another automatically. Lost it? Use /guide for a replacement.

pages.heading: Recover your guide book
pages.body: Use /guide or /kncraft guide to put this book in an empty inventory slot. Every player can use it. A carried copy, including your offhand, prevents duplicates. If your inventory is full, free a slot and retry. Crafting a book with one paper also still works.

pages.heading: From journal to chapter
pages.body: Open a journal record, then select Open in Guide to jump to the relevant KNCraft Guide Book chapter. All records stay independent, without rewards or recipe locks. Read at your own pace and return to the journal when ready.

pages.heading: Values from your server
pages.body: Thermal-food and selected insulation pages request current server definitions while open. They label pack defaults while waiting. Values describe a plain item under your current conditions; item data and other modifiers may change the result.

pages.heading: Your accomplishment journal
pages.body: FTB Quests records bosses, discoveries and mod advancements. Choose any entry, in any order. There are no reward chains, recipe locks or item turn-ins. Existing native advancements can count; revisit landmarks to record new discoveries.

pages.heading: When you need help
pages.body: Use the help form for a server problem and identify KNCraft. Include the location, what happened, and a useful screenshot or error message. Reports are handled by two owners in their spare time; responses can take time. Commands and

pages.heading: When you need help (cont.)
pages.body: cooldowns vary by role. Use the linked roles page for current permissions instead of assuming a command described in another modpack works here.
